plugins.name: compact-timing
plugins.description: Compacts the conversation at task boundaries instead of at a fixed token count: the model marks the session busy or at a boundary, and the plugin compacts at the end of a turn when the mark and the context size allow it

plugins.name: skill-hints
plugins.description: Shows which installed skill fits each prompt you type, as a toast and a status line, and lists every skill in a /skill-hints pane

plugins.name: topic-nudge
plugins.description: Shows a toast when a prompt starts a different topic than the earlier requests in the session, so you can /clear first

plugins.name: grounded
plugins.description: Output style: answer first, keep every figure, do the work you can do, and say what was checked

plugins.name: working-method
plugins.description: Skills for how Claude works on a task: hard multi-step tasks, context docs, surviving a usage limit, and git worktrees
